subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed root cause fix was NOT implemented. The `options` object (lines 55-67) is missing the `live_preview` configuration required for Contentstack Live Preview. There is no `live_preview: { enable: true, host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST }` property in the options passed to `contentstack.Stack(options)`. Without this, the SDK will never include preview parameters in queries and no downstream consumer can receive real-time content updates. Every acceptance criterion related to real-time updates without reload is unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: (1) Add CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN to the env destructuring block (lines 17-25). (2) Add `live_preview: { enable: true, host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, ...(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? { preview_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } : {}) }` to the options object before passing to contentstack.Stack().

issues.description: createContentTypeQuery does not call `query.includeFallback()` when live_preview context is present. The prescribed fix requires accepting an optional live_preview param (content_type_uid, entry_uid) in ICreateQueryConfig and calling includeFallback() so the SDK fetches draft/preview content.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an optional `live_preview?: { content_type_uid: string; entry_uid: string }` field to ICreateQueryConfig, and in createContentTypeQuery call `query.includeFallback()` when live_preview is provided.

issues.description: createContentTypeEntryQuery does not call `query.includeFallback()` when live_preview context is present. Same prescribed fix needed here as in createContentTypeQuery.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an optional `live_preview?: { content_type_uid: string; entry_uid: string }` field to ICreateEntryConfig, and in createContentTypeEntryQuery call `query.includeFallback()` when live_preview is provided.

issues.description: ICreateQueryConfig interface was not updated with the live_preview parameter. The prescribed fix requires adding an optional live_preview field to this interface.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview?: { content_type_uid: string; entry_uid: string }` to ICreateQueryConfig interface.

issues.description: ICreateEntryConfig interface was not updated with the live_preview parameter. The prescribed fix requires adding an optional live_preview field to this interface.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview?: { content_type_uid: string; entry_uid: string }` to ICreateEntryConfig interface.

issues.description: The file does not exist. There is no reactive Provider component with useState for content and useEffect subscribing to live preview events. Without a reactive state mechanism, no downstream consumer (236+ components using useContent) can ever receive live preview updates. Every acceptance criterion for real-time updates is unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: Create a ContentstackProvider component that wraps ContentstackContext.Provider, uses useState to hold content, and uses useEffect to subscribe to Contentstack live preview events (e.g., onEntryChange), updating state when preview data arrives.

issues.description: useContent calls useContext(ContentstackContext) but there is no reactive Provider component supplying a changing value. The hook will always return a static value and cannot propagate live preview updates to the 236+ consumers.
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure useContent consumes a ContentstackProvider that supplies reactive content state, not a static context value.

issues.description: The @contentstack/live-preview-utils dependency is not installed anywhere in the project. No import of this package exists in the codebase. Without the SDK, no Live Preview subscription can be established.
issues.suggestedFix: Install @contentstack/live-preview-utils and import it in the ContentstackProvider to subscribe to live preview events.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests were found for the Live Preview feature. There are no tests mirroring src/context/ for a ContentstackProvider, no tests for live_preview config in options, no tests for includeFallback() behavior, and no tests verifying reactive content updates. The test count has not increased to cover this new feature.
issues.suggestedFix: Add vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ paths: tests for ContentstackProvider reactive behavior, tests verifying live_preview is in Stack options, tests verifying includeFallback() is called when live_preview context is present.
